user.title: Daikin Cycle ML installatie
user.description:
Choose the ESPAltherma source sensor and your heat-pump model.

- **Source sensor**: must expose the 13 required ESPAltherma attributes. Typical: `sensor.althermasensors`.
- **Model**: determines default thresholds. Pick 'Custom' to supply your own attribute map.

data_description.source_sensor: ESPAltherma sensor that exposes the 13 required heat-pump attributes. Typical: sensor.althermasensors.
data_description.model: Your Daikin model. Determines default thresholds. Pick 'Custom' to supply your own attribute map.

model_custom.title: Aangepaste attribuutkoppeling
model_custom.description: Optional JSON mapping from standard keys to your attribute names. Example: `{"INV frequency (rps)": "my_rps"}`. Leave empty to use defaults.

data_description.custom_attribute_map: JSON object mapping standard keys to attribute names, e.g. {"INV frequency (rps)": "my_rps"}.

cycle.title: Cyclusdetectie
cycle.description:
Thresholds that decide when the compressor counts as ON.

- **Compressor RPS threshold** (default 3): ON when RPS ≥ this. Increase to ignore brief spikes.
- **Power sensor** (optional): used as fallback when RPS is unavailable.
- **Fallback power threshold** (default 200 W): lower = more sensitive.

data_description.compressor_rps_threshold: Compressor ON when RPS >= this value. Default 3. Increase to ignore brief spikes.
data_description.power_sensor_entity: Optional. Used as fallback when RPS is unavailable or zero. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.fallback_power_threshold_w: Power threshold (W) for the fallback sensor. Default 200. Lower = more sensitive.
data_description.indoor_temp_sensor: Optionele sensor voor binnentemperatuur (gebruikt voor ML-feature indoor_temp_avg).

pendulum.title: Pendel-drempels
pendulum.description:
Values below mark a cycle as 'short' (pendelen). Lower = stricter, more alerts.

- **Short run** (default 20 min): cycles shorter than this are flagged.
- **Short off** (default 5 min): off-times shorter than this are flagged.
- **Pendulum cycles/day** (default 35-40): daily count that triggers an alert.
- **DHW cycles/hour** (default 3): DHW-specific pendulum trigger.

data_description.short_run_threshold_min: Cycles shorter than this are 'short runs'. Default 20 min. Lower = stricter.
data_description.short_off_threshold_min: Off-times shorter than this are 'short offs'. Default 5 min. Lower = stricter.
data_description.pendulum_cycles_per_day: Daily cycle count that triggers a pendulum alert. Default 35-40. Lower = more alerts.
data_description.dhw_pendulum_cycles_per_hour: DHW cycles per hour that trigger a DHW pendulum alert. Default 3.

quality.title: Kwaliteitsdrempels
quality.description:
Thresholds used to score a cycle 0-100. Meeting a threshold avoids a penalty.

- **Good run** (default 45 min): runtime ≥ this scores full marks. Below: −30 points.
- **Good dT** (default 5.0 K): minimum dT for full marks. Below: −20 points.
- **Good off** (default 20 min): minimum off-time for full marks. Below: −20 points.
- **Target cycles/day** (default 8): efficiency target, used in ratio-based advice.

data_description.good_run_threshold_min: Runtime at or above this scores full marks. Default 45 min. Below = -30 points.
data_description.good_dt_threshold_k: Minimum dT (K) for full marks. Default 5.0 K. Below = -20 points.
data_description.good_off_threshold_min: Minimum off-time for full marks. Default 20 min. Below = -20 points.
data_description.target_cycles_per_day: Target cycles per day for efficient operation. Default 8. Used for ratio-based advice.

notifications.title: Meldingen
notifications.description:
How and when alerts are delivered.

- **Persistent notifications**: sidebar alerts.
- **Notify service** (optional): e.g. `notify.telegram_rachid`.
- **Quiet hours**: suppress non-critical alerts during the window (default 22:00–07:00).

data_description.persistent_enabled: Show alerts as persistent notifications in the sidebar.
data_description.notify_service: Pick a notify entity (recommended) or a legacy notify service. Leave empty to disable push notifications.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Suppress non-critical alerts during the quiet window.
data_description.quiet_hours_start: Start of quiet hours, HH:MM (24h). Default 22:00.
data_description.quiet_hours_end: End of quiet hours, HH:MM (24h). Default 07:00.
